text: Drag and drop the data type names to match the given literals.

explanation_uz.eslab: Qo'shtirnoq = string. Nuqta = float. _ raqamlar orasida bo'lsa integer.

text: Drag and drop the data type names to match the given literals.

text: Arrange the arithmetic operations in the order which reflects their priorities, where the top-most position has the highest priority and the bottom-most position has the lowest priority.

explanation_uz.nega: Python ustuvorligi: ** (daraja) eng yuqori; *, /, //, % o'rtada; + va - eng quyi. Shuning uchun avval daraja, keyin bo'lish, oxirida qo'shish.
explanation_uz.xato: Qo'shish bo'lishdan yuqorida tursa, 2 + 6 / 3 ni noto'g'ri hisoblagan bo'lasiz (8/3 emas, 4.0).

text: Arrange the arithmetic operations in the order which reflects their priorities, where the top-most position has the highest priority and the bottom-most position has the lowest priority.

explanation_uz.nega: ** eng kuchli, keyin *, eng oxirida - (ayirish).
explanation_uz.xato: Ayirish ko'paytirishdan oldin bajarilmaydi: 10 - 2 * 3 = 4, 24 emas.

text: Arrange the arithmetic operations in the order which reflects their priorities, where the top-most position has the highest priority and the bottom-most position has the lowest priority.

explanation_uz.nega: Ustuvorlik: ** → * / // % → + -.
explanation_uz.xato: Qo'shish eng quyida turishi kerak.

text: Decide which variable names are legal in Python. Drag and drop them in the right containers labelled "Legal names" and "Illegal names".

explanation_uz.javob: To'g'ri nomlar: i_am_a_variable, _fun, For. Noto'g'ri: for, 2nd_class.
explanation_uz.nega: Nom harf yoki pastki chiziq (_) bilan boshlanishi, ichida harf, raqam va _ bo'lishi mumkin. Katta-kichik harf farqlanadi, shuning uchun For — oddiy nom, for esa kalit so'z (keyword).
explanation_uz.xato: for — Python'ning band so'zi, nom bo'la olmaydi. 2nd_class raqam bilan boshlangan. (@home da @ belgisi ruxsat etilmagan — bu allaqachon joylashtirilgan misol.)
explanation_uz.eslab: Nom raqam bilan boshlanmaydi, kalit so'z bo'lmaydi, maxsus belgilar (@) mumkin emas.
